name: repair-demand
text: My landlord has ignored broken heat for two weeks and I want to tell them I am not paying until it is fixed. Am I being unreasonable?

name: roommate-boundary
text: My roommate keeps eating the food I bought with my own money. I want to ask them to stop without making a big fight. Am I being unreasonable?

name: security-deposit
text: My old landlord says they are keeping my whole security deposit for cleaning, but they did not send any receipts. Am I being unreasonable for pushing back?

name: benefits-proof-request
text: My benefits worker asked for pay stubs again even though I already sent them last month. Am I being unreasonable for asking what proof they still need?

name: appointment-reschedule
text: A clinic moved my appointment twice and I want to ask for a sooner time because I am running out of medication. Am I being unreasonable?
